_description: Platform address -> branch name mapping. Key — a substring of the Google address OR of the Yandex Metrika organization name (both spellings when they differ, e.g. Russian and Belarusian), value — the branch name in the report. Copy to branches.json and adjust for your chain; keys starting with _ are ignored. An address without a match still appears in the report, cleaned (street with house number, no city or postal code).
